name: HJ Video Downloader
tagline: Paste a link, save any video
description: HJ Video Downloader is a browser-based tool for saving and summarizing online videos. Paste a link to parse it, then download as MP4 with your choice of quality, or extract MP3 audio. Batch downloads are packaged into a zip automatically. It can also generate an AI summary with a timestamped outline, key points and a mind map, then answer follow-up questions about the video. Built on yt-dlp and covers 1000+ sites.
detail: This project is an open-source, self-use oriented practice. There is no database: jobs live in server memory and expire automatically. Only download content you own or have permission to save.
bullets: Supported sites: 1000+, including YouTube, Bilibili, Douyin, Kuaishou, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Vimeo, Twitch, SoundCloud
Output formats: MP4 video with quality selection, MP3 audio
Batch: multiple links at once, auto-packaged as zip; playlists expand automatically
AI summary: one-line overview, timestamped chapters, key points, mind map, follow-up Q&A
Requirements: any modern browser, no sign-up, no installation, works on mobile
Stack: Python 3.13 + Flask + yt-dlp + ffmpeg + OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint
Pricing: payments are not enabled yet, the free tier covers parsing and downloads
